userStories.title: Bounded semantic output normalizer
userStories.description: As an Archon web developer, I want a pure, React-free, provider-agnostic output normalizer exposing bounded semantic channels, so that family bodies can be rendered lazily without unbounded parsing or provider branching.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/tool-output.ts exports normalizeToolOutput(output: unknown): NormalizedToolOutput plus NormalizedToolOutput, BoundedList<T>, ToolOutputMatch, ToolOutputField types and exported display-limit constants (approx 64 Ki code units text, 500 list items)

NormalizedToolOutput exposes simultaneous channels: text, paths, matches, webResults, fields, counts {matches,files}, mode ('content'|'files_with_matches'|'count'|null), unreadable — not a first-hit union

Recognized structures per phase-01 table: plain string / content[{type:'text',text}]; stdout+stderr; file.content / type:'create'+content / FileContent.content / Content.content; Devin output:number[] byte decode (integers 0-255 only, non-fatal TextDecoder); filenames:string[] and Grep paths form; Grep content string and Devin file_matches[{path,matches[{line_number,content}]}]; mode/numMatches/numFiles/count; WebFetch result+url; WebSearch results (string entries or title/url items); shallow own top-level generic fields with scalars as text, objects '{…}', arrays '[n]'
Non-JSON-looking string becomes bounded text with ANSI CSI/OSC (incl. OSC-8)/control sequences stripped during bounded production — no unbounded intermediate string
JSON-looking string at/below parse cap uses JSON.parse; over-cap JSON-looking string is unreadable unless narrow prefix salvage succeeds

Failed-JSON salvage is a bounded state-machine tokenizer recovering only values keyed stdout|stderr|text|content|result; tracks key/value position, quotes, escapes, nesting; cut escape or lone high surrogate ends with U+FFFD; never returns arbitrary last literal; marks unreadable when no honest value recovered
List overflow: '+n more' only when exact source total known (omitted positive int); otherwise truncated:true, omitted:null ('more results omitted'); no unbounded tail scan for an exact count

Existing record/array output inspected directly (never stringified); unknown nested structures ignored; non-finite numbers and symbol/function values contribute nothing; prototype properties never scanned

tool-output.test.ts red-then-green tables cover: Claude Bash JSON, OMP ANSI/OSC text, Devin byte array, Codex plain text, Claude Glob, all Grep modes, Devin file_matches, WebFetch, both WebSearch variants, unknown objects with nested objects/arrays, malformed/truncated JSON at escape boundaries, hostile inputs (undefined/null/number/boolean/array/proxy getter) — none throw; boundary tests at limit and limit+1 and adversarially large inputs for every cap; byte values negative/>255/fractional/non-number never decode or coerce
cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/tool-output.test.ts passes; bun run type-check and bun run lint --max-warnings 0 pass for touched files
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 1 first half (phase-01-start.md §Contract, §Recognized output shapes, §Parsing/truncation/salvage, test matrix rows). Pure TS, no React import. Fixtures from pinned @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.209 sdk-tools.d.ts declarations plus observed OMP event-parser.ts / Devin event-bridge.ts / Codex provider.ts shapes — no exploratory model runs. No provider-name branching, no recursive scans. Do not touch agent-history.ts or the Console allowlist.

userStories.title: Lazy family-body resolver + spec corrections
userStories.description: As an Archon web developer, I want toolBodyPresentation(input, resolvedFamily) added to tool-presentation.ts with per-family body arms, so both room surfaces can lazily render bounded bodies while summary resolution stays cheap and output never reclassifies family.
acceptanceCriteria: tool-presentation.ts exports ToolBody union (terminal|file|matches|paths|code|web|generic), MatchItem, ToolField, and toolBodyPresentation(input: ToolPresentationInput, resolvedFamily: ToolFamily): ToolBody | null per the plan.md proposed contract

toolBodyPresentation uses the supplied family and never invokes family resolution; returns null for todo/task; catches malformed/adversarial values returning bounded unreadable/generic state without throwing

Per-family arms implemented per phase-01 rule table: shell (command from command/cmd/script else complete wrapper-preserving sent name, bounded; output from normalized text; explicit unreadable/empty/running states); file (established path-key priority; preview = normalized text else input content/new_content/new_string/new_str else null; NO diff); search (pattern/scope from existing inputs; structured matches win over line parsing; anchored path:line:text / path-line-text parsing retains unmatched lines as text-only items; truncation/omission metadata preserved); glob (existing Claude-vs-OMP path rule; normalized paths else non-empty text lines; never invents line numbers); code (bounded source+language from input, explicit truncation; result from normalized text); web (url from input; title/results/text from normalized channels; WebSearch results become markdown list content); generic (ONE shared cap of three fields across input then normalized output fields in stable order; plain non-JSON output may become safe markdown after fields; JSON fragments never markdown)

Search mode precedence exactly: (1) recognized input.output_mode, (2) normalized output mode or unmistakable structured channel (filenames/paths vs matches), (3) sent-alias default — exact Claude 'Grep' -> files_with_matches/paths; lowercase 'grep' and other search aliases -> content/matches. Explicit 'count' produces body kind 'generic' with count field/badge while resolved family remains 'search' (excluded from generic-fallback numerator)
Collapsed-badge count extractor stays small/independently bounded and does NOT call the full normalizer; may add recognized numeric JSON keys under its existing low cap

Invariant proven by tests: toolPresentation(...).family is identical with output undefined vs every family fixture's real output; closed-row summary functions (toolPresentation/toolRowPresentation/buildAgentHistory) never invoke full normalization

No serialized provider object/array in any presented body; tests distinguish serialized JSON ({"key":, indented quoted keys) from the required '{…}' marker, legitimate braces in prose/source — no global '{' ban
todo/task fixtures: body resolver returns null; summary behavior unchanged (tested explicitly as receiving no placeholder body)

Spec corrections in same change: tool-presentation-contract.md describes summary vs lazy body APIs separately, adds file-preview and web arms, states todo/task ownership, keeps output unable to reclassify family; test-plan.md audit heading corrected Story 1.2 -> 1.3, 'absent -> matches' replaced with the two sent-alias defaults, generic 'no {' assertion replaced with serialized-syntax rejection allowing '{…}', raw-row vs logical-card denominator conflict recorded and linked to Phase 3 decision

All existing Story 1.1 summary tests still pass; cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/tool-output.test.ts src/lib/tool-presentation.test.ts, bun --filter @archon/web test, bun run type-check, bun run lint --max-warnings 0, bun run format:check all pass

userStories.title: Legacy ToolBody renderer + safe markdown + scoped CSS
userStories.description: As an operator using the Legacy node room, I want expanded tool rows to show the family-appropriate bounded body in the presented-body slot with inert stored markdown, so I can read what ran without opening Raw.
acceptanceCriteria: #175 gate handled: merged #175 code re-scouted (not its draft plan); if no #175 code exists, implement the minimal presented-body/Raw swap slot (body bar + Raw toggle) inside NodeRoom.tsx and record the anchor/state names in evidence

toolBodyPresentation() invoked only on the open && !rawOpen path — never computed unconditionally above JSX; closed row and Raw-open row provably skip it (resolver spy tests); full-output load recomputes body once against fetched output (hasFullOutput -> fullOutput else item.output)
Legacy-local ToolBody switch + restricted markdown component in NodeRoom.tsx; imports only ToolBody types/resolver from @/lib/tool-presentation

Restricted markdown map: no rehype-raw, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML; 'a' renders label + parenthesized destination as inert text (dedup when bare autolink label equals destination; no href/click/target); 'img' renders alt text + '[image omitted]' (never an img, never fetches); headings/paragraphs/lists/blockquotes/inline+fenced code retained; rehype-highlight only rehype plugin, auto-detect disabled, unknown languages non-fatal

Body anatomy per design: .tool-family-body box = surface-inset, 1px border, 6px radius, 8px 10px padding, 11.5px/1.5 mono, pre-wrap, overflow-wrap:anywhere, min-width:0; terminal '$' in node-bash, failure = word/glyph + error color, explicit running/no-output/unreadable copy; file path in node-command + preformatted preview + 'no preview'/unreadable copy; matches show pattern+optional scope, path node-command, ':line' text-secondary; paths one node-command path/line; '+n more' vs 'more results omitted'; code via collision-safe fenced markdown block, language token restricted to [A-Za-z0-9_+.-]+, result in second body box 6px below, unknown language renders plain source; web URL inert text (not an anchor) + optional title + safe markdown; generic 11ch key column, <=3 rows; null body renders NO placeholder box (body bar + Raw remain)

Scoped CSS only: .tool-family-body .hljs-* overrides in index.css (keyword/title/built-in = color-mix(in oklch, var(--node-prompt) 70%, var(--text-primary)); strings = var(--success); comments/annotations = var(--text-secondary); base = var(--text-primary), transparent background); no new token or dependency; >=4.5:1 contrast vs surface-inset recorded

Component tests in NodeRoom.test.tsx/LegacyNodeRoom.test.tsx cover: closed row no resolver call; open shell success/failure; matches/search-paths/glob-paths anatomy incl. no invented line numbers and overflow indicators; unknown generic <=3 rows + '{…}'/'[n]' + full sent name in header/title; Raw toggle unmounts/restores body and skips resolver while open; markdown attack fixtures (explicit links, autolinks, images, raw HTML, javascript: URLs, external image URLs) assert no active a/img/raw element reaches DOM; file normal/empty/unreadable; code known/unknown language + long backtick runs; WebFetch/WebSearch; truncated-at-rest + full-output recompute; todo/task null body; keyboard order summary -> Raw -> full-output/Retry preserved with 24x24 targets/focus/reduced-motion

Verification: cd packages/web && NODE_ENV=development bun test src/components/workflows/NodeRoom.test.tsx src/components/workflows/LegacyNodeRoom.test.tsx passes; bun run type-check, lint --max-warnings 0, format:check pass

userStories.title: Read-only generic-fallback audit CLI
userStories.description: As a release operator, I want an import-safe read-only audit that counts the generic-fallback fraction over logical UI tool cards, so the release gate measures exactly what the UI presents.
acceptanceCriteria: Denominator decision recorded in test-plan.md + reports/: adopt the plan's Recommended decision (logical-tool-cards-v1) unless the repo shows an owner-ratified alternative; do not implement both candidate metrics

scripts/audit-generic-fallback.ts created: importing it performs NO arg parsing/connection/output/file write; main() runs only under import.meta.main; no implicit database target (no ~/.archon/DATABASE_URL fallback); default live invocation prints result only; --record requires explicit output path/flag + atomic temp-file rename; check path reads only the record + classification/pairing source set (never opens a database)

Audit semantics: enforced read-only handle (SQLite true readonly + PRAGMA query_only; PostgreSQL if selected = direct client + read-only transaction, NEVER PostgresAdapter or transitive pg import); consistent snapshot; selects only id, workflow_run_id, node_id, seq, payload id/name/input, output-key-present boolean, metadata tool_phase/occurrence/attempt via dialect JSON projection — output bodies never leave the database; validates projections into minimal PairableMessage with inert sentinel for output-presence; groups per (workflow_run_id,node_id) ordered by seq; calls projectToolTranscript(); counts each projected tool-card once (pending call-only and legacy result-only count; text/status don't); toolPresentation({name,input,output:undefined}); numerator = family==='generic'

Scalability: stable keyset paging inside the snapshot; only current node group + aggregates held; documented per-node tool-row ceiling fails closed with actionable error; entire corpus never loaded into memory

Threshold via integer arithmetic genericCards*100 >= logicalCards*2 — exactly 2% fails, no float ambiguity; fail closed on malformed rows or zero-card corpus; errors use distinct nonzero exit codes for policy vs invocation/data/access failure

Record schema per phase-03 (schemaVersion, generatedAt UTC, non-secret source id, dialect, denominator, auditSourceSha256 covering classification+pairing source files, logicalCards, genericCards, informational fraction); checker recomputes fraction from integers and rejects disagreement; credentials/payloads/file paths/DB URLs/absolute DB paths never enter stdout or record; generic tool names aggregated only per recorded privacy decision (deterministic count-desc/name-asc order, capped)

audit-generic-fallback.test.ts covers: two modern pairs + pending call + legacy result-only + text/status rows -> correct logical-card denominator; call/result split across keyset page boundary pairs once; same tool id in different nodes/runs never cross-pairs; exact 2%/below/above; default prints only (no record); explicit record atomic + recomputable; child-process import has no DB/file access or output; readonly fixture proves main DB bytes unchanged, no script-created journal/WAL/SHM, writes impossible; missing/stale/hash-mismatched/malformed/zero record fails release check; malformed row fails closed reporting row identity without payload contents; very large output body proves only presence projected; access failure never falls back to another DB/write-capable adapter; large fixture + node above ceiling -> bounded memory + fail-closed
Fixture DBs live in temp dirs passed explicitly and removed in finally; ARCHON_HOME and DATABASE_URL scrubbed in subprocess env
bun test ./scripts/audit-generic-fallback.test.ts passes (never root bun test); bun run type-check/lint pass
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 3 audit half (phase-03 §Blocking decision, §Proposed audit semantics, §Command safety contract, §Audit tests). NEVER import @archon/core DB connection — adapters apply schema on construction. If PostgreSQL selected, test against repo's existing PostgreSQL CI service or isolated local test DB with default_transaction_read_only — SQLite fixture is not proof of both dialects.
